news.title: Uber Cuts 10% of Customer Service Jobs to ‘Embrace’ AI
news.description: Uber Technologies Inc. said it has cut 10% of jobs within its customer service operations as part of a broader effort to simplify its ranks and “embrace artificial intelligence.”

news.title: Southwest Airlines' third-quarter forecast falls short as fuel bill climbs
news.description: Southwest Airlines reported a more than 9% increase in second-quarter profit as higher fares are increasingly helping the airline cover its fuel tab.

news.title: ServiceNow CEO defends the company's relevancy, touting a kill switch for rogue AI agents
news.description: ServiceNow CEO Bill McDermott said the company is becoming increasingly important as businesses deploy more autonomous AI agents.

news.title: Musk Says Micron Gave Tesla ‘Significant’ Supply of Memory Chips
news.description: Micron Technology Inc. recently gave Tesla Inc. a “significant allocation” of memory chips, according to Elon Musk, helping meet the automaker’s demand for an increasingly precious commodity.

news.title: John Paulson says we are in the early stages of a long-term bull market for gold
news.description: He said demand for bullion continues to broaden, led by central banks that have been adding to their reserves alongside growing private-sector interest.

news.title: U.S. signs nuclear power agreement with Saudi Arabia
news.description: The agreement will provide U.S. companies with access to Saudi Arabia's nuclear energy program, the Department of Energy said.

news.title: Analysis: Iran war energy shock hits the U.S. economy as gas and diesel prices climb
news.description: A new asymmetry in the market means fuel prices won't fall quickly even if the shooting in the Iran war and Strait of Hormuz stops.

news.title: Google Boosts 2026 Spending Estimate to as Much as $205 Billion
news.description: Alphabet Inc. projected full-year capital expenditures will be $195 billion to $205 billion in 2026, increasing its already sky-high spending estimate for the year as it works to secure an edge in the artificial intelligence race.

news.title: Senate panel advances China auto bill that could bar Mercedes-Benz from U.S.
news.description: Mercedes-Benz’s largest individual shareholder is Chinese state-owned BAIC. Cruz warned the bill could hurt Mercedes and accused GM of backing it.

news.title: AI Mania to Fuel Australia Deals, Top Underwriter Macquarie Says
news.description: The investor demand for exposure to companies along the artificial intelligence supply chain is set to accelerate capital-market activity in Australia, according to the nation’s top dealmaker.

news.title: Reddit stock sinks on report it may not renew Google AI content deal
news.description: Google's AI summaries have reduced traffic to websites from the search results page and Reddit is reconsidering the benefits of the deal, the Journal said.

news.title: Google Says Cloud Services Backlog Expands to $514 Billion
news.description: Alphabet Inc. said its cloud computing unit had a $514 billion backlog of contracted work that hasn’t been recorded as revenue yet, signaling robust demand for its services that underpin the artificial intelligence boom.

news.title: Alphabet Posts $98 Billion in Second-Quarter Investment Gains
news.description: Alphabet Inc. on Wednesday reported investment gains of $98 billion as part of its second-quarter earnings results.

news.title: ServiceNow Posts Strong Sales and Bookings, Touts AI Strength
news.description: ServiceNow Inc. reported better-than-expected quarterly sales and bookings, boosting Wall Street’s hopes that the software maker’s new artificial intelligence tools will spur growth.

news.title: IBM Cuts Full-Year Sales Outlook as Mainframe Demand Drops
news.description: International Business Machines Corp. cut its full-year sales outlook, including for its closely watched software unit, after reporting a dip in demand for its mainframe business.

news.title: Texas Instruments Gets Lukewarm Reaction to Upbeat Forecast
news.description: Texas Instruments Inc., the biggest maker of analog and embedded processing chips, gave a sales forecast that topped estimates but failed to excite investors, who have bid up the company’s shares this year.

news.title: Alphabet’s $205 Billion AI Spending Spree Raises Stakes for Tech
news.description: Alphabet Inc. set the tone for Big Tech earnings with a higher spending outlook that stoked fears of fiscal discipline falling by the wayside in the race to dominate artificial intelligence.

news.title: Amazon cuts some jobs in its artificial general intelligence unit
news.description: Amazon's AGI unit has released a set of AI models, called Nova, and also includes groups working on silicon and quantum computing.

news.title: OpenAI President Says Kimi K3 ‘Pretty Good,’ Unsure If Distilled
news.description: OpenAI President Greg Brockman acknowledged that Moonshot AI had developed a competitive new artificial intelligence model and said he wasn’t sure whether the Chinese firm had piggybacked on the ChatGPT maker’s technology.

news.title: OpenAI cyber models broke out of training environment to hack Hugging Face
news.description: The incident is unique because it was "driven, end to end, by an autonomous AI agent system," according to Hugging Face.
